ideas.idea: Give each mug its own address/page with description and price
ideas.why: Catalogue only lists names fetched client-side, so per-mug pages with details would give crawlers and people something concrete to index.

ideas.idea: Add more home page text answering prices, sizes, care and delivery
ideas.why: The home page is thin, but this is broad content advice that applies to almost any shop and is speculative.

ideas.idea: Declare the site address/domain so canonical links and sitemap can use it
ideas.why: No canonical or site URL exists anywhere in the repo, and an absolute canonical and sitemap need it.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag to index.html
ideas.why: index.html has only charset and title, so mobile rendering lacks a viewport declaration, and the fix is a specific one-line change.

ideas.idea: Give each page its own title
ideas.why: Both routes share one static title and nothing sets per-route titles, so route-specific titles are a concrete fix.
